record.paper_title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
record.original_question: Let p be prime, U a multiplicative subgroup of Z_p^*, v a nonzero residue class, and R = vU. A known result assumes #R >= 10^8 p^(7/8) log^(5/2) p and then finds an element a in R whose continued-fraction partial quotients for a/p have sum at most 500 log p log log p, yielding D(a,p) << log p log log p. Can the exponent 7/8 in the subgroup-size hypothesis be replaced by a smaller exponent while retaining such a conclusion?

evidence.quote: Let p be prime, U be a multiplicative subgroup in Z∗p . For v 6= 0 we consider the set R = v · U and let #R ≥ 108 p7/8 log5/2 p.
Then there exists an element a ∈ R, a/p = [b1 , b2 , · · · , bl ], bi = bi (a), l = l(a) with Σ bi ≤ 500 log p log log p, and hence D(a, p) ≪ log p log log p.
An open problem here is as follows. Is it possible to replace exponent 7/8 in the condition (63) by a smaller one?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime, let $U$ be a multiplicative subgroup of $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$, let $v\in(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$, and set $R = vU \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. For an integer $a$ with $1\le a<p$ and $\gcd(a,p)=1$, write the (finite) regular continued fraction expansion
$$\frac{a}{p}=[b_1,b_2,\dots,b_l],\qquad b_i=b_i(a),\ l=l(a),$$
and define the discrepancy-type quantity $D(a,p)$ as the discrepancy of the sequence $\{ka/p\}_{k=1}^{p-1}$ modulo $1$ (so that $D(a,p)\ll \frac{1}{p}\sum_{i=1}^{l(a)} b_i$).

It is known that there exists an absolute constant such that whenever
$$\#R \;\ge\; 10^8\, p^{7/8}\,\log^{5/2} p,$$
one can find an element $a\in R$ with
$$\sum_{i=1}^{l(a)} b_i(a) \;\le\; 500\,\log p\,\log\log p,$$
and consequently $D(a,p)\ll \log p\,\log\log p$.

Problem: Determine whether the exponent $7/8$ in the size hypothesis $\#R\ge 10^8 p^{7/8}\log^{5/2}p$ can be replaced by a strictly smaller exponent $\theta<7/8$ (possibly with a different implicit constant and a different power of $\log p$) while still guaranteeing the existence of an element $a\in R$ whose continued-fraction partial quotients for $a/p$ satisfy $\sum_i b_i(a)\ll \log p\,\log\log p$ (so that $D(a,p)\ll \log p\,\log\log p$).
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a paper explicitly improving the exponent 7/8 in the stated subgroup-size hypothesis for the continued-fraction / discrepancy bound on cosets of multiplicative subgroups of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. No source clearly establishing the improvement (or its impossibility) was located, so the current status is taken as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Diophantine exponents of lattices and growth of multidimensional analogues of partial quotients
status_evidence.snippet: General work on Diophantine exponents and partial quotients; does not address the 7/8 exponent for multiplicative-subgroup cosets.
